arithmetic: integers (120 W, 2 Q, 60 R) and Q(sqrt5); floats only for printed phases

walk.symmetry: W and R commute with all sixty rotations acting on ports and addresses

per_tick_on_second_index.basis: x = rest component (blank record, uniform address), y = component along Q hat; second index in body axes (normal, short, long) of the base port
per_tick_on_second_index.map: (x, y) -> (-y, x + 2 K3 y), first index untouched
per_tick_on_second_index.mixed_axes: short and long (entry 2/60); the normal axis is a level

conserved_by_the_internal_walk_and_the_M: all sixty rotations of the internal register (first index, and the rotation multiplet: slow = 3, fast = 3prime, middle inside 5); not conserved: the axis lines of the second index

passage_between_carriers.relabelling: nu = F P for every frame (the right translation by the half-turn about the short axis of the base port); on the seam of each axis it agrees with the left half-turn about the short axis of the seam ports
passage_between_carriers.second_index: multiplied by diag(-1, +1, -1) in (normal, short, long): the axis lines are kept up to sign
